title: Madison
text:
I am a current graduate student at Cornell University seeking my Masters of Professional Studies (MPS) in Natural Resources and The Environment with a concentration in Forest Ecology.
My previous work has included invasive species management and ecosystem restoration in Oahu, Hawaii.
I plan to go on a 4-6 month exhibition in June 2027 to kayak the entire Missouri River from source (Montana) to sea (Gulf of Mexico)
